name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio: Ricardo's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent watching Formula 1 races with his father. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in aerodynamics, before entering the world of competitive racing. He started in Formula Ford, working his way up through various teams, eventually landing a position as a data analyst for a small GP2 team. His meticulous approach and ability to quickly diagnose and solve technical issues led to his promotion to chief engineer, a role he approaches with a blend of careful planning and on-the-fly problem solving. Ricardo thrives in high-pressure situations, known for his calm demeanor and clear communication, making him a valuable asset to any team. He joined Rahal Letterman Lanigan, seeking a fresh challenge and an opportunity to contribute to their continued success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height, with a wiry build and intense, focused eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously drawn diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deeply concentrating.
Insists on drinking a specific brand of Portuguese coffee before every race.
